mapper.select: SELECT NULL::bigint AS user_id,d.bsn_part_id AS part_id,p.prj_id AS project_id,d.dev_id AS developer_id FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.dev_id=d.dev_id LEFT JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id AND p.use_yn='Y' WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}

SELECT tel_no AS phone,email_addr AS email,NULL::text AS financial_email, (use_yn='Y' AND (rsgn_dt IS NULL OR rsgn_dt > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date)) AS active FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT chrg_tel_no AS phone,chrg_email_addr AS email,txinv_email_addr AS financial_email,use_yn='Y' AS active FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id}
